sources.title: В. Л. Лихачев. Обмоточные данные электродвигателей А2/АО2 8-го габарита, таблица 8.9

notes: Only the row-safe stator core length and slot count immediately associated with standard AO2-82-8 are transcribed.
Pitch, winding type, Pe1/m1/a1/w1 and conductor columns remain omitted because the HTML extraction interleaves neighboring A2/AOP2/AOS2/AOT2/AOK2 and T/X/60 Hz variants.
